projects.title: Gradetrail : Open-Source LLM Evaluation Harness
projects.description: Built and published gradetrail, an open-source Python LLM evaluation harness that enables reproducible model benchmarking through declarative YAML-based evals, multi-provider execution, and response caching. Supports evaluation across Anthropic, OpenAI, and local models with the same benchmark definition, scales from local execution to Ray-based distributed runs, and reduces a 500-sample benchmark runtime by 5.4× (176s → 33s). Designed a request-identity cache that eliminated redundant API costs, built a lightweight web viewer for analyzing failures and comparing runs, and added engineering rigor through reproducibility manifests, CI, and 292 automated tests.

projects.title: Cityscapes Instance Segmentation
projects.description:
Performed Instance Segmentation on a subset of the Cityscapes dataset based on
the Mask R-CNN architecture proposed by Facebook.Used a version of the network implemented by Matterport,
pre-trained on the COCO dataset.
